71122.pair: Overlapping rear-ski/equipment region; singleton/group identity HOLD

99184.reason: Both boxes contain parts of multiple people, but occlusion and overlap alone do not prove an invalid grouped detection. Worker strong single-person-invalidity claim is not promoted.

scientific_disposition: No newly accepted clean first-physical-revisit control from this six-image basket. Numerical nearness, poor localization and physical recurrence remain distinct. Stop visual backfill.
